fusions.name: Coiled Fang
fusions.desc: Spits a fang that deals 8 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. It holds up to 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Venom Spreads
fusions.desc: Every enemy within 3.5 tiles takes 12 damage. Your afflictions on a target spread to enemies within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Shed Venom
fusions.desc: Removes up to 3 poison conditions from you. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Tightening Coil
fusions.desc: When you afflict an enemy, your critical hit chance rises by 15% for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
